# Migration to the Text 0.4.3 candidate

The seven capability IDs and the directory profile are unchanged. SQL accepts optional dialect, indent and keywordCase. A text-only request produces the former generic, four-space, uppercase result. The other capabilities retain their text-only schemas. The SQL response still contains text. The packaged Text View continues to use the generic defaults. Common dense 8 KiB SQL templates now complete within the existing Worker budget. The 0.4.2 directory remains available. This unsigned candidate requires separate Studio install and lifecycle acceptance.
